verdict.rationale: LlamaParse offers BYOC/self-hosting so customers can keep all data under their own infrastructure control, and cites SOC2 Type II/HIPAA compliance, which implies some data governance posture, but no evidence describes an explicit data retention policy, configurable retention windows, or a deletion API/mechanism for the managed SaaS offering. missing for 10: explicit retention period documentation, a data deletion API/endpoint, and confirmation of deletion behavior for managed (non-BYOC) deployments.
